an6.55:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an6.55:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Soṇo Rājagahe viharati Sītavanasmiṃ.
an6.55:1.4: Atha kho āyasmato Soṇassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
an6.55:1.5: ‘ye kho keci Bhagavato sāvakā āraddhaviriyā viharanti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro,
an6.55:1.6: atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati, saṃvijjanti kho pana me kule bhogā, sakkā bhogā ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ;
an6.55:1.7: yan nūnāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ puññāni ca kareyyan' ti.
an6.55:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmato Soṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam aññāya, seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva kho Gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito Sītavane āyasmato Soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.
an6.55:2.3: āyasmā pi kho Soṇo Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an6.55:2.4: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Soṇaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca
an6.55:3.1: ‘nanu te Soṇa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
an6.55:3.2: ye kho keci Bhagavato sāvakā āraddhaviriyā viharanti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro,
an6.55:3.3: atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati, saṃvijjanti kho pana me kule bhogā, sakkā bhogā ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ;
an6.55:3.4: yan nūnāhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ puññāni ca kareyyan' ti?
an6.55:4.2: kusalo tvaṃ pubbe āgārikabhūto vīṇāya tantissare' ti?
an6.55:4.4: ‘Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Soṇa, yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo accāyatā honti, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā' ti?
an6.55:5.1: ‘Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Sona, yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo atisithilā honti, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā' ti?
an6.55:6.1: ‘Yadā pana te Soṇa vīṇāya tantiyo na accāyatā honti na atisithilā same guṇe patiṭṭhitā, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā' ti?
an6.55:7.1: ‘Evam eva kho Soṇa accāraddhaviriyaṃ uddhaccāya saṃvattati, atilīnaviriyaṃ kosajjāya saṃvattati.
an6.55:7.2: Tasmā ti ha tvaṃ Soṇa viriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhaha indriyānañ ca samataṃ paṭivijjha tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhī' ti.
an6.55:7.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Soṇo Bhagavato paccassosi.
an6.55:7.4: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Soṇaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā, seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva kho Sītavane antarahito Gijjhakūṭe pabbate pāturahosi. 2.
an6.55:8.1: Atha kho āyasmā Soṇo aparena samayena viriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhahi indriyānañ ca samataṃ paṭivijjhi tattha ca nimittaṃ aggahesi.
an6.55:8.2: Atha kho āyasmā Soṇo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirass' eva yass' atthāya kulaputtā samma-d-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi,
an6.55:8.3: ‘khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā' ti abbhaññāsi.
an6.55:8.4: Aññataro ca panāyasmā Soṇo arahataṃ ahosi.
an6.55:9.1: Atha kho āyasmato Soṇassa arahattappattassa etad ahosi
an6.55:9.2: ‘yan nūnāhaṃ yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkameyyaṃ, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato santike aññaṃ vyākareyyan' ti.
an6.55:9.3: Atha kho āyasmā Soṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Soṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: 3.
an6.55:10.1: Yo so bhante bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto, so cha ṭṭhānāni adhimutto hoti:
an6.55:10.2: nekkhammādhimutto hoti, pavivekādhimutto hoti, avyāpajjhādhimutto hoti, taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti, upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti, asammohādhimutto hoti. 4.
an6.55:11.1: Siyā kho pana bhante idh' ekaccassa āyasmato evam assa
an6.55:11.2: ‘kevalaṃ saddhāmattakaṃ nūna ayam āyasmā nissāya nekkhammādhimutto' ti.
an6.55:11.3: Na kho pan'etaṃ bhante evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.55:11.4: Khīṇāsavo bhante bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo karaṇīyaṃ attano asamanupassanto katassa vā paticayaṃ khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti. 5.
an6.55:12.1: Siyā kho pana bhante idh' ekaccassa āyasmato evam assa
an6.55:12.2: ‘lābhasakkārasilokaṃ nūna ayam āyasmā nikāmayamāno pavivekādhimutto' ti.
an6.55:12.3: Na kho pan'etaṃ bhante evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.55:12.4: Khīṇāsavo bhante bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo karaṇīyaṃ attano asamanupassanto katassa vā paticayaṃ khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā pavivekādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā pavivekādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā pavivekādhimutto hoti. 6-9.
an6.55:13.1: Siyā kho pana bhante idh' ekaccassa āyasmato evam assa
an6.55:13.2: ‘sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ nūna ayam āyasmā sārato paccāgacchanto avyāpajjhādhimutto' ti.
an6.55:13.3: Na kho pan'etaṃ bhante evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
an6.55:13.4: Khīṇāsavo bhante bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo karaṇīyaṃ attano asamanupassanto katassa vā paticayaṃ khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā avyāpajjhādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā avyāpajjhādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā avyāpajjhādhimutto hoti . . .
an6.55:14.1: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti . . .
an6.55:15.1: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti . . .
an6.55:16.1: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā asammohādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā asammohādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā asammohādhimutto hoti. 10.
an6.55:17.1: Evaṃ sammāvimuttacittassa bhante bhikkhuno bhusā ce pi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, nev'assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti,
an6.55:17.2: amissīkatam ev'assa cittaṃ hoti, ṭhitaṃ ānejjappattaṃ, vayañ c' assānupassati.
an6.55:17.3: Bhusā ce pi sotaviññeyyā saddā . . . pe . . .
an6.55:17.7: manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, nev'assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti,
an6.55:17.8: amissīkatam ev'assa cittaṃ hoti, ṭhitaṃ ānejjappattaṃ, vayañ c' assānupassati. 11.
an6.55:17.9: Seyyathā pi bhante selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekaghano,
an6.55:17.10: atha puratthimāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, neva naṃ saṃkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya, atha pacchimāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi . . . pe . . .
an6.55:17.11: atha uttarāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi . . .
an6.55:17.12: atha dakkhiṇāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, neva naṃ saṃkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya:
an6.55:17.13: evam eva kho bhante evaṃ sammāvimuttacittassa bhikkhuno bhusā ce pi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, nev'assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti,
an6.55:17.14: amissīkatam ev'assa cittaṃ hoti, ṭhitaṃ ānejjappattaṃ, vayañ c' assānupassati,
an6.55:17.15: bhusā ce pi sotaviññeyyā saddā . . . pe . . .
an6.55:17.19: manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ. āgacchanti, nev'assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti,
an6.55:17.20: amissīkatam ev'assa cittaṃ hoti, ṭhitaṃ ānejjappattaṃ, vayañ c' assānupassatī ti.
